description: This file defines the ShippingMethod controller class in the Opencart system, specifically within the checkout namespace. It includes methods for managing shipping methods during checkout process, such as index, quote, and save, and interacts with session data, models, and views to facilitate shipping options.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Controller class for handling shipping method selection during checkout, extending the core system controller, with methods for displaying available shipping options, quoting, and saving selected methods.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping method selection page, loading language and view components, and retrieving any existing selected shipping method from session.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Returns available shipping methods in JSON format, validating cart contents, customer, and address data, and loading shipping models to retrieve method options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected shipping method based on POST data, validating the input, updating session data, and returning success or error messages in JSON format.
